hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes swap quotes using a configurable bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from another vault, fully replacing Uniswap v4's native concentrated liquidity mechanism via BeforeSwapDelta. Standard liquidity additions and donations are blocked.
